purpose: Assess AmphiBIO coverage for every species actually detected in the 7,848 complete NAAMP community runs before defining functional-diversity endpoints.
species_universe: union of active species across the same eligible runs used by NAAMP_ECOLOGICAL_PULSE_CONTRACT_V0_1.json

future_panel_gate.core_functional_panel: traits must be complete for >=80% of uniquely matched active species and have nonzero variance
future_panel_gate.secondary_life_history_panel: traits complete for >=60% may be used only for species-level secondary analyses
future_panel_gate.complex_taxa: unmatched species-complex records remain unmatched; do not assign constituent traits

prohibited: no rainfall-response models in this audit
no trait selection from effect directions
